executive_summary.text: Cost year 2025: direct care cost was $192.94 per resident day (48.6% of expenses); Connecticut median $174.45.
Cost year 2025: nursing home operating margin was -33.1% (Connecticut median 2.5%).
Cost year 2025: nursing pool (agency) staff counted in direct care cost $1,880,824, 29.6% of the $6,350,820 direct care cost.

Cost year 2025: dietary cost $898,890, $27.31 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.51). Wages $423,866 (47.2%), allocated fringe $63,691 (7.1%), non-wage costs $411,333 (45.8%). Raw food was $366,344 ($11.13 per resident day; Connecticut median $8.61) and purchased dietary services $6,347.
Cost year 2025: housekeeping cost $392,993, $11.94 per resident day (Connecticut median $12.32). Wages $318,235 (81.0%), allocated fringe $47,818 (12.2%), non-wage costs $26,940 (6.9%).
Cost year 2025: laundry cost $177,908, $5.4 per resident day (Connecticut median $5.66). Wages $148,117 (83.3%), allocated fringe $22,256 (12.5%), non-wage costs $7,535 (4.2%).
Missing data: cost years 2015, 2017, 2019, 2020 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data)

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
